# spec-003 T1 — copy preservation snapshot
#
# Literal, user-facing strings from the eight files named in spec-003's
# "Copy preservation contract", extracted BEFORE any spec-003 source edit.
# Existing strings below must remain byte-identical after the restyle, even
# if moved between widgets or conditionally hidden.
#
# Approved additions/changes (NOT required to appear below, but the ONLY
# copy allowed to be new/changed per spec-003 "Copy preservation contract"):
#   - "Your vault, in a file you own."
#   - C-1 metadata subtitles ("On this device · biometrics on/off",
#     "Google Drive · synced <relative time>") and the C-2 Drive-account
#     fallback ("Google Drive account")
#   - "Locate" and locate-mismatch guidance
#     ("Selected file does not match the missing database. Use \"Open
#     existing database\" instead.")
#   - "Step 1 of 3", "Step 2 of 3", "Step 3 of 3", "KDBX Vault Manager app storage"
#   - duplicate consequence lines: "Save this file as another database.",
#     "Back up, then replace the existing file.",
#     "Discard this import and open the existing database."
#   - "Unlock with key file"
#   - "Key file not found. Locate or select the required key file."
#   - decrypting/Face ID strings in FR-5 ("Decrypting <basename>",
#     "Deriving your encryption key with Argon2. This can take a moment.",
#     "Use Face ID for <basename>?")
#   - basename-only invalid/corrupt sheet titles required by C-3
#
# No other copy rewrite is in scope for spec-003.
